name: ReactionBar
description:
Reactions with counts, each a toggle named for what it says: "2 people reacted with thumbs
up", pressed when one of them is the current person. The bar is one tab stop (R11.5) and
arrow keys move along it in reading order. The add control comes first, so a reaction
arriving at the end moves nothing. The picker loads on demand when it first opens.
signature: ({ reactions, defaultReactions, onReactionsChange, readOnly, disabledReason, suggested, picker, className, "aria-label": label, ...rest }: ReactionBarProps): import("react").JSX.Element | null

props.name: defaultReactions
props.description: The reactions at first when uncontrolled. The bar counts the person's own changes itself.

props.name: disabledReason
props.description: Why this person cannot react now. Reactions and the add control stay, disabled, and show it (R12.3).

props.name: onReactionsChange
props.type: ((reactions: readonly Reaction[], change: ReactionChange) => void) | undefined
props.description: Called when a person adds or removes a reaction, with the next reactions and the change.

props.name: picker
props.description: Offer the add control. Without it people only join the reactions already drawn. Default true.

props.name: reactions
props.description: The reactions, controlled, in the order to draw them.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Show the counts with no way to react: no buttons and no add control.

props.name: suggested
props.description: Emoji offered first in the picker. Default 👍 ❤️ 😄 🎉 😮 😢.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
